subject: [PATCH] btrfs: fix double release of data space on failed direct IO COW write

2026-11-16.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the Btrfs file system where data space is released twice when a direct IO COW write fails, leading to an underflow of bytes_may_use and potential warnings or clamping to zero. The fix involves recording the extent consumed by btrfs_reserve_extent() in dio_data and releasing only the remaining reserved data space from bytes_may_use on error paths. This patch can be applied to stable kernels later than v5.19, which rewrote the affected error path.
